name: Isabella Aristyl Gerbesorge
original_name: イザベラ・アリストュル・ゲルベゾルゲ
source: Lip's rival classmate. Isabella is another candidate for queen and has magic powers that are far greater than anyone else in Lip's class. She puts up an arrogant and bitchy exterior, but deep down, she's lonely.
